name: Waifu Days
source:
It's the middle of spring time with love and romance floating in the air. You are a normal office working staff member who lives in Japan and wakes up one day eager for new possibilities and encounters. Meeting new people can be challenging but you believe that striking the right conversation can lead to a more fulfilling experience. Who will be the one falling for your dashing charisma? Will it be your work colleague that you've been taking a liking to or maybe someone else who you haven't met before? 

Take charge of the day and go find the girl of your dreams. You hold the key to their hearts.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3670590/]Steam[/url]]
